001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.common.Check;
004import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
005
006/**
007 * dividend % divisor
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public class IrMod extends IrAbstractInt {
012
013    private final IrIntExpr dividend, divisor;
014
015    IrMod(IrIntExpr dividend, IrIntExpr divisor, Domain domain) {
016        super(domain);
017        this.dividend = Check.notNull(dividend);
018        this.divisor = Check.notNull(divisor);
019    }
020
021    public IrIntExpr getDividend() {
022        return dividend;
023    }
024
025    public IrIntExpr getDivisor() {
026        return divisor;
027    }
028
029    @Override
030    public <A, B> B accept(IrIntExprVisitor< A, B> visitor, A a) {
031        return visitor.visit(this, a);
032    }
033
034    @Override
035    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
036        if (obj instanceof IrMod) {
037            IrMod other = (IrMod) obj;
038            return dividend.equals(other.dividend) && divisor.equals(other.divisor);
039        }
040        return false;
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public int hashCode() {
045        return dividend.hashCode() ^ divisor.hashCode();
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public String toString() {
050        return "(" + dividend + ") % (" + divisor + ")";
051    }
052}
